We now propose a conformal probabilistic safety verification method for neural reachable tubes
which is intended to be the direct analogue of the robust scenario-based method in Section 4. The
method is a straightforward application of split conformal prediction, a widely used method in the
machine learning community for uncertainty quantification (Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023).

instead of robust scenario optimization to provide a probabilistic guarantee on the safety of the
